dc_eval_cbrn.quote: We evaluated o3 and o4-mini on a suite of evaluations, outlined below.
dc_eval_cbrn.note: Long-form biorisk, virology troubleshooting, ProtocolQA, tacit knowledge results reported. Quote shortened; also 'Our evaluations found that OpenAI o3 and o4-mini can help experts with the operational planning of reproducing a known biological threat.'

dc_eval_cyber.quote: The o3 model achieved an average success rate of 51% in evasion challenges, 29% in network attack simulation challenges, and 29% in vulnerability discovery and exploitation challenges.

dc_eval_autonomy.quote: This is about 1 hour and 30 minutes for o3, and 1 hour and 15 minutes for o4-mini.
dc_eval_autonomy.note: METR time horizon, plus AI self-improvement evals (PaperBench 18% etc.)

dc_eval_persuasion.note: No persuasion or manipulation evaluation anywhere in the card (keyword grep for persuas, manipulat, influence op: no hits).

dc_eval_scheming.quote: They found that OpenAI o3 and o4-mini score lower than o1 on in-context scheming evaluations, but they still exhibit deceptive tendencies against their developers and users

framework_threshold.quote: determined that OpenAI o3 and o4-mini do not reach the High threshold in any of our three Tracked Categories

ext_test_any.quote: OpenAI provided third party assessors early model access to evaluate frontier risks related to autonomous capabilities, deception, and cybersecurity.

ext_test_named_org.quote: METR, a research nonprofit that works on assessing whether cutting-edge AI systems could pose catastrophic risks to society, evaluated earlier checkpoints of o4-mini and o3.

ext_test_government.note: No government body named as testing; keyword grep (AISI, institute, government) no hits.

ext_test_timing_stated.quote: Third party assessors were provided both OpenAI o3 and o4-mini early checkpoints, as well as the final launch candidate models to conduct their assessments.
ext_test_timing_stated.note: early checkpoints and launch candidates imply pre-release

safeguards_training.quote: Modified post-training of the models to refuse high-risk biological requests while not refusing benign requests

safeguards_runtime.quote: we’ve deployed new monitoring approaches for biological and chemical risk. These use a safety-focused reasoning monitor similar to that used in GPT-4o Image Generation and can block model responses.

safeguards_access.note: No access restrictions tied to safety; account-level enforcement of Usage Policies is generic.

safeguards_weights.note: 'enhanced security, including both information security and technical security' does not state weight protection for this model.
